北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大体感凉，注意保暖防风防干燥哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and feels cool, remember to keep warm, protect from wind and dryness!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波有雾风力大，行车注意安全，及时添衣！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is foggy and windy, drive carefully and add clothes promptly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有霾天气凉，出门记得戴口罩，注意健康。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has haze and cool weather, remember to wear a mask when going out for your health.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨风力大，带伞添衣，小心路滑哟！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain and strong winds, bring an umbrella, add clothes, and watch out for slippery roads!
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳体感舒适，记得多喝水，防潮哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels comfortable, remember to drink more water and stay dry!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾风力大，出行注意交通安全，别着凉！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy and windy, be safe when traveling and avoid catching a cold!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天风力大，体感较凉，多穿衣物哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and windy, feeling cool, so wear more clothes!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云天气舒适，外出散步，心情棒棒哒！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is partly cloudy and comfortable, perfect for a walk, feeling great!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云体感微凉，出门记得带件薄外套哟！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is partly cloudy and feels a bit cool, remember to bring a light jacket when going out!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗微凉，出门多穿衣，别忘了补水！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and a bit cool, wear more clothes when going out, and remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云舒适，出门走走，享受好时光吧！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is partly cloudy and comfortable, go out for a stroll and enjoy the good times!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天寒地冻，全副武装，注意防滑保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is freezing cold, bundle up completely, and be careful of slippery surfaces and stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷风力大，注意添衣保暖，别冻着啦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, cold, and windy, remember to add clothes, keep warm, and don't catch a cold!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天体感宜人，外出散步，记得带件外套。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels pleasant, take a walk, and remember to bring a jacket.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天体感温暖，多喝水，注意防潮哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and feels warm, drink more water, and be aware of humidity!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风力超大，务必多穿，外出注意安全！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is extremely windy, make sure to bundle up, and stay safe outdoors!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连风大体感冷，注意防风保暖，别感冒哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is windy and feels cold, pay attention to wind protection and warmth, don't catch a cold!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦有雾体感舒适，开车慢行，注意安全。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is foggy and comfortable, drive slowly and be safe!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微凉，记得添衣，保持好心情呀！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and a bit cool, remember to add clothes and stay cheerful!
